title: 36th Annual Graham & Dodd Event with Li Lu '96, Founder and Chairman of Himalaya Capital
description: A conversation with Li Lu '96 (’96 CC,’96 LAW), Founder and Chairman of Himalaya Capital and Tano Santos, the Robert Heilbrunn Professor of Asset Management and Finance, Faculty Director, Heilbrunn Center for Graham & Dodd Investing
summary: The speaker outlines six core principles of value investing: three derived from Ben Graham (stock as ownership, market serves the investor, and investing requires predicting the unpredictable future with a margin of safety), one from Warren Buffett (staying within a circle of competence and knowing its edge), and one from Charlie Munger (fishing where the fish are). The speaker notes that while the discipline has evolved over nearly 100 years, these core principles remain timeless and have guided their practice for over 30 years.
